$comment: English label and description of each event type of spec/eventos-webhooks.json (copied from the accounts catalog, in Spanish, and checked by its SHA-256). scripts/generate.mjs takes the trigger's built-in event list texts from here and refuses to generate if a subscribable type has no entry. The live catalog the trigger reads from the API is shown as the API returns it.

device.disconnected.label: Number disconnected
device.disconnected.description: One of the account's WhatsApp numbers disconnected and can no longer send or receive.

device.connected.label: Number connected
device.connected.description: One of the account's WhatsApp numbers got connected: when the QR code is scanned or a WhatsApp Cloud number finishes its setup.

billing.payment_failed.label: Payment failed
billing.payment_failed.description: A subscription charge could not be processed (Stripe subscriptions only). Sent once per invoice, on the first failed attempt; not repeated on charge retries. AI top-ups are not included.

billing.plan_blocked.label: Plan blocked
billing.plan_blocked.description: The plan was blocked because of a charge that was not processed.

billing.upcoming_charge.label: Upcoming charge
billing.upcoming_charge.description: The next subscription charge is near (Stripe subscriptions only); the notice arrives a few days before the charge date.

subscription.expiring.label: Subscription expiring
subscription.expiring.description: The subscription is about to expire.

subscription.trial_ending.label: Trial ending
subscription.trial_ending.description: The trial period is about to end; the notice arrives 1 to 3 days before the end, depending on how it was purchased.

subscription.reactivated.label: Subscription reactivated
subscription.reactivated.description: The scheduled cancellation of the subscription was reverted (Stripe subscriptions only): it stays active and renews on the given date.

subscription.cancellation_confirmed.label: Cancellation confirmed
subscription.cancellation_confirmed.description: The cancellation of the subscription was confirmed (Stripe subscriptions only): access is kept until the given date.

subscription.dormant_ending.label: Dormant period ending
subscription.dormant_ending.description: The dormant account period is about to end (the notice arrives about 7 days before); on that date the given charge is attempted.

ai_quota.low_balance.label: AI quota low
ai_quota.low_balance.description: The account's AI message quota is about to run out.

ai_quota.topup_succeeded.label: AI top-up succeeded
ai_quota.topup_succeeded.description: An AI quota top-up was credited.

ai_quota.topup_failed.label: AI top-up failed
ai_quota.topup_failed.description: An AI quota top-up could not be processed.

mac.usage_80.label: Monthly active contacts at 80%
mac.usage_80.description: The account reached 80% of its monthly active contacts for the cycle.

mac.usage_100.label: Monthly active contacts at 100%
mac.usage_100.description: The account used up its monthly active contacts for the cycle; a 24-hour grace period starts, and its end comes in grace_expires_at.

mac.expiring.label: Monthly active contacts expiring
mac.expiring.description: Some monthly active contacts expire in the next 7 days.

account.blocked.label: Account blocked
account.blocked.description: The account was blocked for usage: the 24-hour grace period after using up the monthly active contacts ended without being settled.

message.received.label: Message received
message.received.description: A contact wrote to one of the account's WhatsApp numbers. device_id identifies that number and may be null.

flow.completed.label: Flow completed
flow.completed.description: A contact finished an automation flow.

broadcast.finished.label: Broadcast finished
broadcast.finished.description: A broadcast reached its final state (sent, failed or partially failed), with its counts.

contact.stage_changed.label: Contact changed stage
contact.stage_changed.description: A contact moved to another stage of a board.

message.status_changed.label: Message status changed
message.status_changed.description: The delivery status of a sent message changed: status is sent, delivered, read or failed, with previous_status, the error when it failed, and the client_reference sent with the message.

conversation.closed.label: Conversation closed
conversation.closed.description: The conversation with a contact was closed.

conversation.assigned.label: Conversation assigned
conversation.assigned.description: The conversation with a contact was assigned to a person or to the AI.

contact.tag_added.label: Tag added to a contact
contact.tag_added.description: A tag was added to a contact.

broadcast.paused.label: Broadcast paused
broadcast.paused.description: A broadcast was paused because of the number's quality.

contact.tag_removed.label: Tag removed from a contact
contact.tag_removed.description: A tag was removed from a contact.

template.status_changed.label: Template status changed
template.status_changed.description: The status of a WhatsApp template changed.

whatsapp_form.completed.label: WhatsApp form completed
whatsapp_form.completed.description: A contact completed a WhatsApp form sent from one of the account's numbers, with the form, the message_id of the send, the contact, the number and the answers.

group.invite_link_down.label: Invite link down
group.invite_link_down.description: A group's invite link stopped working.

group.invite_link_renewed.label: Invite link renewed
group.invite_link_renewed.description: A group's invite link was renewed.

scheduled_message.group_delivery_failed.label: Scheduled message not delivered to a group
scheduled_message.group_delivery_failed.description: A scheduled message could not be delivered to a group. It replaces the campaigns' failed message alert and covers more cases.

scheduled_message.response_received.label: Reply to a scheduled message
scheduled_message.response_received.description: A reply to a scheduled message was received.

poll.voted.label: Poll vote
poll.voted.description: Someone voted in a poll sent to a group.

group.blocked.label: Group blocked
group.blocked.description: A campaign group was blocked and cannot be used.

group.recovered.label: Group recovered
group.recovered.description: A group that was blocked is available again.

scheduled_message.finished.label: Scheduled message finished
scheduled_message.finished.description: A scheduled message finished going out to its groups, with its result and the count of groups that failed.

group_action.failed.label: Group action failed
group_action.failed.description: A group action failed as a whole (if it finished with per-person results, group_action.completed arrives instead). If the API asked for it, action.uuid is the action_id it returned.

daily_report.generated.label: Daily report generated
daily_report.generated.description: The account's daily report was generated (clicks, joins and leaves).

campaign.no_groups_available.label: Campaign without available groups
campaign.no_groups_available.description: A campaign has no groups to send the people who come in through its link to.

group.full.label: Group full
group.full.description: A group went from not full to full.

group_action.completed.label: Group action completed
group_action.completed.description: A group action finished. action.uuid is the action_id the API returned when it was requested, action.type says which action it was, and result depends on the type.

group.message_received.label: Message received in a group
group.message_received.description: A person wrote a message in a group.

group.reaction_added.label: Reaction in a group
group.reaction_added.description: A person reacted to a message in a group.

group_join_request.created.label: Request to join a group
group_join_request.created.description: A person asked to join an official group that requires approval, and the request is pending. It can be approved or rejected through the API with the person's phone.

group_join_request.revoked.label: Request to join withdrawn
group_join_request.revoked.description: A person withdrew a pending request to join a group before it was approved or rejected.
